This is an automated PR created by the daily-codegen circleci job.

Please review and merge if the changes look correct.

Note that only these files should have been modified:

- [addresses.json](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/blob/main/superchain/extra/addresses/addresses.json)
- [chainList.json](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/blob/main/chainList.json)
- [chainList.toml](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/blob/main/chainList.toml)

For more details see the [runbook](https://www.notion.so/oplabs/superchain-registry-daily-codegen-294f153ee162803788cdee48ec542ca4?v=d784200583d9415587c4dcd2b0c64b2f).
